marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 20 knots diminishing to light near midnight then
increasing to south 20 Friday morning. Wind veering to west 20 early Friday
evening. Scattered showers changing to periods of drizzle near
midnight then to rain near noon Friday with a risk of freezing rain. Fog
patches. Low tonight zero. High Friday plus 5. <br/>
